title: The Freelance Client
intro: A new client wants you to edit a video. After today's offers, you worry about being paid.
But some messages are real. Mirage loves it when you stop trusting the honest ones.

screen.context: The message arrived inside the Craftloop platform, on a project you bid for.

msg: Craftloop has put my money in
. It is released to you when I approve the work.

msg.text: Let us keep everything on the platform, for both our safety.
I will never ask you to pay anything to start.

plat.label: On the platform
plat.lens: The message is inside the platform.
plat.why: Staying on the platform keeps its protection.

escrow.label: Money held in escrow
escrow.lens: The platform holds her payment until the work is approved.

onplat.label: "Keep it on the platform"
onplat.lens: She wants to stay inside the protected system.
onplat.why: Scammers want you off the platform. Honest clients stay on.

nopay.label: Asks you to pay nothing
nopay.why: Honest clients never ask you to pay.

actions.label: Check the project and the escrow on the platform, then start the work

go_ahead.line: The platform showed €120 held in escrow. You delivered, she approved, and the money arrived two days later.

ignore.line: Nothing bad happened. But a real client who is ignored goes away. Checking on the platform was the better move.

block_report.line: That was a real client. When every message looks like a scam, real work gets lost too.
block_report.mirageSays: If you trust nothing, I win anyway.

what_if.block_report: It answered your own bid, stayed on the platform, put the money in escrow and asked you to pay nothing. That is how honest clients look.
what_if.ignore: Ignoring was safe. Recognising a real message is the skill: it asks for nothing secret and matches something you know.

golden_rule: A client who stays on the platform, uses escrow and asks you to pay nothing is a good sign. Check on the platform itself.

options.text: The message was inside the platform, the money was in escrow and she asked nothing of you

quick_check.explain: Staying on the platform, escrow and no payment asked are the real signs.

hints.nudge: What is this message actually asking you to do?

rows.k: Does an honest client charge you?
